rules.numericalRules: Reuse exact v0.4 candidate rules without changing numbers; separate signed workload_compatibility approval required.
rules.evidenceDates: Require explicit current-capability and weekly-evidence confirmations plus a valid longest-session observation date; future or missing dates are not current evidence.
rules.entry: Preserve adult, comfortable walking, experience, completion goal, health and interruption checks.
rules.calendar: Use exact v0.5 calendar rules; do not require uncollected session-time answers.
rules.validation: Require full authored-program and schedule validation before initial-week publication.
rules.unknownMeasurementWindows: Weekly averages and individual longest sessions remain incomparable without equivalent measurement definitions and windows; never label their numeric difference contradictory.
rules.fallback: Missing evidence, failed rules or missing signed dependencies block publication.
rules.scope: Initial week only. No automatic progression or adaptation.

reviewRequired: Clinical and coaching suitability of v0.4 numerical entry rules
Use of explicit current confirmations as evidence freshness
First-week publication with no authorized future-week progression
